meta.title: Our story — Jameye
meta.description: Jameye is a creator-driven social forecasting platform, built in Stockholm. Make your own forecasts, explain your thinking, and follow the outcome.

hero.body: Jameye is built in Stockholm, Sweden by an international team of hedge fund quants, math Olympiads, MIT alumni and seasoned entrepreneurs.

title.ital: Years of research have shown it.

body: In a four-year tournament funded by the US intelligence community, researchers recruited tens of thousands of ordinary people and asked them to predict the world's biggest geopolitical events.

The best of them — the superforecasters — were over 30% more accurate than intelligence analysts with access to classified information. Amateurs, working off the open internet, beat the professionals working off the world's most guarded secrets.

stat.label: More accurate
stat.detail: Superforecasters vs. intelligence analysts with classified access

edge.body: The strongest predictor of becoming a superforecaster was the commitment to constantly update beliefs and improve.

sport.body: Jameye is a creator-driven social forecasting platform. Creators start the conversation on culture, entertainment, sport, science and society. You make your own call, explain why, and come back to see how it unfolds.

cards.title: Timing
cards.body: Make your call before the outcome is known — before the reveal, result or announcement.

cards.title: Reasoning
cards.body: Be clear about why. Share the clues and arguments behind your forecast.

cards.title: Open-mindedness
cards.body: Consider different views and what could change your mind as events unfold.

score.title: Come back when the answer is known.
score.body: Compare it with your forecast, reflect on your reasoning, and learn for the next one.

fair.body: Creators start the conversation. Everyone makes their own call — and explains why.

closing.body: Bring your curiosity. Make a call of your own. Try the Jameye beta at play.jameye.com.
